title: 08. Evaluation, Validation & Tuning: Model Validation Techniques — runnable code

sections.title: Example 1: Train-Test Split
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 1: Train-Test Split")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate classification data
X_clf, y_clf = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    random_state=42,
)

# Simple train-test split
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X_clf, y_clf, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_clf
)

print(f"Training set size: {X_train.shape[0]}")
print(f"Test set size: {X_test.shape[0]}")
print(f"Training set class distribution: {np.bincount(y_train)}")
print(f"Test set class distribution: {np.bincount(y_test)}")

# Train and evaluate model
model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

train_score = model.score(X_train, y_train)
test_score = model.score(X_test, y_test)

print(f"\nTrain accuracy: {train_score:.4f}")
print(f"Test accuracy: {test_score:.4f}")
print(f"Overfitting indicator: {train_score - test_score:.4f}")

# Visualize train-test split
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.scatter(
    X_train[:, 0], X_train[:, 1], c=y_train, cmap="viridis", alpha=0.7, label="Training"
)
plt.title("Training Set")
plt.xlabel("Feature 1")
plt.ylabel("Feature 2")
plt.legend()

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(
    X_test[:, 0], X_test[:, 1], c=y_test, cmap="viridis", alpha=0.7, label="Test"
)
plt.title("Test Set")
plt.xlabel("Feature 1")
plt.ylabel("Feature 2")
plt.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 2: K-Fold Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 2: K-Fold Cross-Validation")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate regression data
X_reg, y_reg = make_regression(n_samples=1000, n_features=5, noise=20, random_state=42)

# K-Fold Cross-Validation
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
model_reg = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)

cv_scores = cross_val_score(model_reg, X_reg, y_reg, cv=kf, scoring="r2")
print(f"K-Fold CV Scores: {cv_scores}")
print(f"Mean CV Score: {cv_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")

# Manual K-Fold implementation
fold_scores = []
fold_predictions = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X_reg)):
    X_fold_train, X_fold_val = X_reg[train_idx], X_reg[val_idx]
    y_fold_train, y_fold_val = y_reg[train_idx], y_reg[val_idx]

    # Train model
    model_reg.fit(X_fold_train, y_fold_train)

    # Predict
    y_pred = model_reg.predict(X_fold_val)
    fold_predictions.append(y_pred)

    # Score
    score = r2_score(y_fold_val, y_pred)
    fold_scores.append(score)

    print(f"Fold {fold + 1}: R² = {score:.4f}")

print(f"\nManual K-Fold Results:")
print(f"Mean Score: {np.mean(fold_scores):.4f}")
print(f"Standard Deviation: {np.std(fold_scores):.4f}")

# Visualize K-Fold results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# CV scores
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.bar(range(1, 6), fold_scores)
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("R² Score")
plt.title("K-Fold Cross-Validation Scores")
plt.axhline(
    y=np.mean(fold_scores),
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    label=f"Mean: {np.mean(fold_scores):.4f}",
)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Predictions vs Actual for first fold
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
y_val_first = y_reg[kf.split(X_reg).__next__()[1]]
y_pred_first = fold_predictions[0]
plt.scatter(y_val_first, y_pred_first, alpha=0.6)
plt.plot(
    [y_val_first.min(), y_val_first.max()],
    [y_val_first.min(), y_val_first.max()],
    "r--",
    lw=2,
)
plt.xlabel("Actual Values")
plt.ylabel("Predicted Values")
plt.title("Fold 1: Predictions vs Actual")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Score distribution
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.hist(fold_scores, bins=5, alpha=0.7, edgecolor="black")
plt.xlabel("R² Score")
plt.ylabel("Frequency")
plt.title("Distribution of CV Scores")
plt.axvline(
    x=np.mean(fold_scores),
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    label=f"Mean: {np.mean(fold_scores):.4f}",
)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 3: Stratified K-Fold Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 3: Stratified K-Fold Cross-Validation")
print("-" * 50)

# Create imbalanced dataset
X_imb, y_imb = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    weights=[0.8, 0.2],
    random_state=42,
)

print(f"Original class distribution: {np.bincount(y_imb)}")

# Compare regular K-Fold vs Stratified K-Fold
kf_regular = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

model_clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)

# Regular K-Fold
regular_scores = cross_val_score(
    model_clf, X_imb, y_imb, cv=kf_regular, scoring="accuracy"
)
print(f"Regular K-Fold CV Scores: {regular_scores}")
print(
    f"Regular K-Fold Mean: {regular_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {regular_scores.std() * 2:.4f})"
)

# Stratified K-Fold
stratified_scores = cross_val_score(model_clf, X_imb, y_imb, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy")
print(f"Stratified K-Fold CV Scores: {stratified_scores}")
print(
    f"Stratified K-Fold Mean: {stratified_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {stratified_scores.std() * 2:.4f})"
)

# Check class distribution in folds
print("\nClass distribution in Stratified K-Fold:")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_imb, y_imb)):
    train_dist = np.bincount(y_imb[train_idx])
    val_dist = np.bincount(y_imb[val_idx])
    print(f"Fold {fold + 1}: Train {train_dist}, Val {val_dist}")

# Visualize comparison
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# CV scores comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
x = np.arange(5)
width = 0.35
plt.bar(x - width / 2, regular_scores, width, label="Regular K-Fold", alpha=0.8)
plt.bar(x + width / 2, stratified_scores, width, label="Stratified K-Fold", alpha=0.8)
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Regular vs Stratified K-Fold")
plt.xticks(x, [f"Fold {i+1}" for i in range(5)])
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Score distributions
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.hist(regular_scores, bins=5, alpha=0.7, label="Regular K-Fold", edgecolor="black")
plt.hist(
    stratified_scores, bins=5, alpha=0.7, label="Stratified K-Fold", edgecolor="black"
)
plt.xlabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.ylabel("Frequency")
plt.title("Score Distributions")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Box plot comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.boxplot(
    [regular_scores, stratified_scores], labels=["Regular K-Fold", "Stratified K-Fold"]
)
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Score Comparison")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 4: Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (Loocv)
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 4: Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV)")
print("-" * 50)

# Use smaller dataset for LOOCV (computationally expensive)
X_small, y_small = make_classification(
    n_samples=100,
    n_features=5,
    n_informative=3,
    n_redundant=1,
    n_classes=2,
    random_state=42,
)

# LOOCV
loo = LeaveOneOut()
model_small = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)

# Cross-validation scores
loo_scores = cross_val_score(model_small, X_small, y_small, cv=loo, scoring="accuracy")
print(f"LOOCV Scores (first 10): {loo_scores[:10]}")
print(f"LOOCV Mean: {loo_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {loo_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")
print(f"Number of evaluations: {len(loo_scores)}")

# Manual LOOCV implementation (for demonstration)
manual_scores = []
for train_idx, val_idx in loo.split(X_small):
    X_train_loo, X_val_loo = X_small[train_idx], X_small[val_idx]
    y_train_loo, y_val_loo = y_small[train_idx], y_small[val_idx]

    model_small.fit(X_train_loo, y_train_loo)
    score = model_small.score(X_val_loo, y_val_loo)
    manual_scores.append(score)

print(f"\nManual LOOCV Mean: {np.mean(manual_scores):.4f}")

# Compare with K-Fold
kf_small = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
kf_scores = cross_val_score(
    model_small, X_small, y_small, cv=kf_small, scoring="accuracy"
)

print(f"\nComparison:")
print(f"LOOCV: {loo_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {loo_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")
print(f"5-Fold CV: {kf_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {kf_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")

# Visualize LOOCV results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Score distribution
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.hist(loo_scores, bins=20, alpha=0.7, edgecolor="black")
plt.xlabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.ylabel("Frequency")
plt.title("LOOCV Score Distribution")
plt.axvline(
    x=loo_scores.mean(),
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    label=f"Mean: {loo_scores.mean():.4f}",
)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Cumulative mean
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
cumulative_mean = np.cumsum(loo_scores) / np.arange(1, len(loo_scores) + 1)
plt.plot(cumulative_mean)
plt.xlabel("Number of Evaluations")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Mean Accuracy")
plt.title("LOOCV Convergence")
plt.axhline(
    y=loo_scores.mean(),
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    label=f"Final Mean: {loo_scores.mean():.4f}",
)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Comparison with K-Fold
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.boxplot([loo_scores, kf_scores], labels=["LOOCV", "5-Fold CV"])
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("LOOCV vs K-Fold CV")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 5: Time Series Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 5: Time Series Cross-Validation")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate time series data
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 200
time_index = pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=n_samples, freq="D")
X_ts = np.random.randn(n_samples, 5)
y_ts = np.cumsum(np.random.randn(n_samples)) + 10  # Random walk with trend

# Time Series Split
tscv = TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=5)

print("Time Series Split Information:")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(tscv.split(X_ts)):
    print(f"Fold {fold + 1}: Train size: {len(train_idx)}, Val size: {len(val_idx)}")
    print(f"  Train period: {time_index[train_idx[0]]} to {time_index[train_idx[-1]]}")
    print(f"  Val period: {time_index[val_idx[0]]} to {time_index[val_idx[-1]]}")

# Train and evaluate
model_ts = LinearRegression()
ts_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(tscv.split(X_ts)):
    X_train_ts, X_val_ts = X_ts[train_idx], X_ts[val_idx]
    y_train_ts, y_val_ts = y_ts[train_idx], y_ts[val_idx]

    model_ts.fit(X_train_ts, y_train_ts)
    y_pred_ts = model_ts.predict(X_val_ts)
    score = r2_score(y_val_ts, y_pred_ts)
    ts_scores.append(score)

    print(f"Fold {fold + 1}: R² = {score:.4f}")

print(
    f"\nTime Series CV Mean: {np.mean(ts_scores):.4f} (+/- {np.std(ts_scores) * 2:.4f})"
)

# Visualize time series validation
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))

# Time series plot with splits
plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
plt.plot(time_index, y_ts, label="Time Series", alpha=0.7)

colors = ["red", "blue", "green", "orange", "purple"]
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(tscv.split(X_ts)):
    plt.scatter(
        time_index[train_idx],
        y_ts[train_idx],
        c=colors[fold],
        alpha=0.3,
        label=f"Fold {fold+1} Train",
        s=10,
    )
    plt.scatter(
        time_index[val_idx],
        y_ts[val_idx],
        c=colors[fold],
        alpha=0.8,
        label=f"Fold {fold+1} Val",
        s=20,
    )

plt.xlabel("Time")
plt.ylabel("Value")
plt.title("Time Series with Cross-Validation Splits")
plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# CV scores
plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
plt.bar(range(1, 6), ts_scores)
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("R² Score")
plt.title("Time Series CV Scores")
plt.axhline(
    y=np.mean(ts_scores),
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    label=f"Mean: {np.mean(ts_scores):.4f}",
)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Predictions vs Actual for last fold
plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
last_train_idx, last_val_idx = list(tscv.split(X_ts))[-1]
y_val_last = y_ts[last_val_idx]
y_pred_last = model_ts.predict(X_ts[last_val_idx])
plt.scatter(y_val_last, y_pred_last, alpha=0.6)
plt.plot(
    [y_val_last.min(), y_val_last.max()],
    [y_val_last.min(), y_val_last.max()],
    "r--",
    lw=2,
)
plt.xlabel("Actual Values")
plt.ylabel("Predicted Values")
plt.title("Last Fold: Predictions vs Actual")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Score trend
plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
plt.plot(range(1, 6), ts_scores, "bo-")
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("R² Score")
plt.title("Score Trend Across Folds")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 6: Group K-Fold Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 6: Group K-Fold Cross-Validation")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate data with groups (e.g., patients with multiple samples)
np.random.seed(42)
n_groups = 20
samples_per_group = 10
n_samples = n_groups * samples_per_group

# Create groups
groups = np.repeat(range(n_groups), samples_per_group)

# Generate features and target
X_group = np.random.randn(n_samples, 5)
# Add group-specific effects
group_effects = np.random.randn(n_groups) * 2
y_group = (
    np.sum(X_group, axis=1) + group_effects[groups] + np.random.randn(n_samples) * 0.5
)

# Group K-Fold
gkf = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
model_group = LinearRegression()

group_scores = []
group_predictions = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(gkf.split(X_group, y_group, groups=groups)):
    X_train_group, X_val_group = X_group[train_idx], X_group[val_idx]
    y_train_group, y_val_group = y_group[train_idx], y_group[val_idx]
    groups_train, groups_val = groups[train_idx], groups[val_idx]

    print(
        f"Fold {fold + 1}: Train groups: {len(np.unique(groups_train))}, Val groups: {len(np.unique(groups_val))}"
    )

    model_group.fit(X_train_group, y_train_group)
    y_pred_group = model_group.predict(X_val_group)
    score = r2_score(y_val_group, y_pred_group)
    group_scores.append(score)
    group_predictions.append(y_pred_group)

    print(f"  R² = {score:.4f}")

print(
    f"\nGroup K-Fold CV Mean: {np.mean(group_scores):.4f} (+/- {np.std(group_scores) * 2:.4f})"
)

# Compare with regular K-Fold
kf_group = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
regular_group_scores = cross_val_score(
    model_group, X_group, y_group, cv=kf_group, scoring="r2"
)

print(f"\nComparison:")
print(f"Group K-Fold: {np.mean(group_scores):.4f} (+/- {np.std(group_scores) * 2:.4f})")
print(
    f"Regular K-Fold: {regular_group_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {regular_group_scores.std() * 2:.4f})"
)

# Visualize group validation
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# CV scores comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
x = np.arange(5)
width = 0.35
plt.bar(x - width / 2, group_scores, width, label="Group K-Fold", alpha=0.8)
plt.bar(x + width / 2, regular_group_scores, width, label="Regular K-Fold", alpha=0.8)
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("R² Score")
plt.title("Group vs Regular K-Fold")
plt.xticks(x, [f"Fold {i+1}" for i in range(5)])
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Group effects visualization
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
unique_groups = np.unique(groups)
group_means = [y_group[groups == g].mean() for g in unique_groups]
plt.bar(unique_groups, group_means)
plt.xlabel("Group")
plt.ylabel("Mean Target Value")
plt.title("Group Effects")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Predictions vs Actual for first fold
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
first_train_idx, first_val_idx = list(gkf.split(X_group, y_group, groups=groups))[0]
y_val_first = y_group[first_val_idx]
y_pred_first = group_predictions[0]
plt.scatter(y_val_first, y_pred_first, alpha=0.6)
plt.plot(
    [y_val_first.min(), y_val_first.max()],
    [y_val_first.min(), y_val_first.max()],
    "r--",
    lw=2,
)
plt.xlabel("Actual Values")
plt.ylabel("Predicted Values")
plt.title("First Fold: Predictions vs Actual")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 7: Validation Strategy Comparison
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Exercise 1: Validation Strategy Comparison Compare different validation strategies (train-test split, k-fold, stratified k-fold, LOOCV) on the same…
- Project 1: Automated Validation Strategy Selector Process: 1.
- Model validation is crucial for reliable performance estimation 2.
- Compare different validation strategies on the same dataset
- Bar plot of scores
- Add value labels on bars

```python
print("\nExample 7: Validation Strategy Comparison")

# Compare different validation strategies on the same dataset
X_compare, y_compare = make_classification(
    n_samples=500,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    random_state=42,
)

model_compare = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)

# Different validation strategies
strategies = {
    "Train-Test Split": train_test_split(
        X_compare, y_compare, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_compare
    ),
    "5-Fold CV": KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
    "10-Fold CV": KFold(n_splits=10, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
    "Stratified 5-Fold": StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
    "LOOCV": LeaveOneOut(),
}

results = {}

for name, strategy in strategies.items():
    if name == "Train-Test Split":
        X_train_comp, X_test_comp, y_train_comp, y_test_comp = strategy
        model_compare.fit(X_train_comp, y_train_comp)
        score = model_compare.score(X_test_comp, y_test_comp)
        results[name] = {"score": score, "std": 0}
    else:
        scores = cross_val_score(
            model_compare, X_compare, y_compare, cv=strategy, scoring="accuracy"
        )
        results[name] = {"score": scores.mean(), "std": scores.std()}

# Display results
print("Validation Strategy Comparison:")
for name, result in results.items():
    if result["std"] == 0:
        print(f"{name}: {result['score']:.4f}")
    else:
        print(f"{name}: {result['score']:.4f} (+/- {result['std'] * 2:.4f})")

# Visualize comparison
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Bar plot of scores
plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
names = list(results.keys())
scores = [results[name]["score"] for name in names]
stds = [results[name]["std"] * 2 for name in names]

bars = plt.bar(names, scores, yerr=stds, capsize=5, alpha=0.8)
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Validation Strategy Comparison")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, score in zip(bars, scores):
    plt.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 0.01,
        f"{score:.4f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )

# Computational cost comparison
plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
computational_cost = {
    "Train-Test Split": 1,
    "5-Fold CV": 5,
    "10-Fold CV": 10,
    "Stratified 5-Fold": 5,
    "LOOCV": len(X_compare),
}

costs = [computational_cost[name] for name in names]
plt.bar(names, costs, alpha=0.8)
plt.ylabel("Number of Model Fits")
plt.title("Computational Cost")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Score vs Cost
plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
plt.scatter(costs, scores, s=100, alpha=0.7)
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    plt.annotate(name, (costs[i], scores[i]), xytext=(5, 5), textcoords="offset points")
plt.xlabel("Computational Cost")
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Score vs Computational Cost")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Best strategy recommendation
plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
best_strategy = max(results.keys(), key=lambda x: results[x]["score"])
plt.text(
    0.5,
    0.5,
    f'Best Strategy:\n{best_strategy}\n\nScore: {results[best_strategy]["score"]:.4f}',
    ha="center",
```
